question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8371db78cec9b2fad92b3e6f0795050190fb3cf7181f08b5175d762ca2383e99.png]
solution:
The given image shows a pattern:**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/835fdeb2ea461b3958dee9e5ef4687de11901762e9b3dd3565e6b760fcd01323.png] 

 
• **The head of the triangle moves clockwise in four directions in this order i.e. Up, left, down and right.**
 
• **The circle turns solid after every alternate step.​**

**​**Next step in this series will be:

 
• **Head of the triangle will face upwards because of the clockwise movement** (as it was facing left in the last step)
 
• **Circle will be hollow because of alternative nature** (as it was solid in the last step)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/835fdeb2ea461b3958dee9e5ef4687de11901762e9b3dd3565e6b760fcd01323.png] 

On comparing the pattern of the last step with the given options we get:

**Option 1 matches with the pattern.**

Hence the correct answer is option 1**​
